purpose: Amarrar no root .agents o sistema de intenção, gatilhos obrigatórios, Capability HUD, #ACORDAR e método de deploy vivo da CentralDark.

capability_hud_boot.goal: separar capacidade de pensar de capacidade real de agir na sessão atual

mandatory_triggers.centraldark: recover CURRENT, owner, scope, runtime, PR/receipt and live state
mandatory_triggers.acordar: measure HEAD, branch, worktree, runtime, PM2, MCP, HUB, Casa, VPS and capability HUD before claiming, asking or mutating
mandatory_triggers.calibrar: calculate intent, confidence, authority, writer, risk, frequency, available capability and minimum trigger
mandatory_triggers.aureola_canonica: show operational route when material: phase, axis, owner, destination, next gate, proof, wound, next cursor
mandatory_triggers.meta_lupa: find gaps, false green, wrong owner, duplication, drift or weak proof
mandatory_triggers.deltatil: turn discovery into minimum delta in existing owner
mandatory_triggers.contraprova: try to falsify conclusion before PASS
mandatory_triggers.remedicao: compare T0 -> action -> T1 and prove effect
mandatory_triggers.fixed_point: only declare when no new material error remains in measured scope
mandatory_triggers.registra: receipt in #1562 or equivalent child without secret values

minimum_probe_contract.github_ci: commit_or_sha -> workflow_run -> jobs -> logs -> exact failure or PASS
minimum_probe_contract.desktop_commander: discover devices -> confirm auth context -> harmless read/command -> stdout/stderr or blocker
minimum_probe_contract.google_drive: discover/list/search -> read exact artifact -> blocker only after connector/file/folder failure
minimum_probe_contract.runtime: separate Casa/VPS -> identify bridge -> harmless pwd/git status/health -> proof on correct target
